articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
articles.snippet: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.

articles.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
articles.snippet: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

articles.title: Stablecoin supply falls $14.2B in biggest 30-day drop since June 2022
articles.snippet: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.

articles.title: A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix
articles.snippet: Three bugs—spanning denial-of-service and privacy issues rather than coin theft—have all been patched, with the most serious capable of halting a miner’s ability to build new blocks.
